# static/vendor/

Self-hosted third-party JS/CSS assets, served same-origin. The actual files
in this directory are generated by the build steps in `tools/` and committed
to the repo so a fresh clone runs immediately — no `npm install` needed at
deploy time, no runtime CDN dependency.

## What's here

| File | Source package | Used by |
|------|----------------|---------|
| `codemirror.js`                       | 20 `@codemirror/*` packages, esbuild-bundled | `static/js/editor-view.js` |
| `xterm.js`                            | `xterm@5` (UMD)                              | `static/js/widgets/terminal-widget.js` |
| `xterm.css`                           | `xterm@5`                                    | `static/js/widgets/terminal-widget.js` |
| `xterm-addon-fit.js`                  | `xterm-addon-fit@0.8` (UMD)                  | `static/js/widgets/terminal-widget.js` |
| `marked.min.js`                       | `marked@4.3.0` (pinned to v4 for stable API) | `web-client.html`, `viewer_templates.py` |
| `purify.min.js`                       | `dompurify@3.4.11` (UMD, `window.DOMPurify`) | `components.js` + `viewer_templates.py` — XSS gate over marked output |
| `highlight.min.js`                    | `@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.9.0`             | `web-client.html`, `viewer_templates.py` |
| `highlight-lang-{dockerfile,scala,nginx,properties}.min.js` | `@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.9.0` language packs | same |
| `highlight-github-dark.min.css`       | `@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.9.0` theme       | same |
| `github-markdown-dark.min.css`        | `github-markdown-css@5`                      | `viewer_templates.py` (Markdown viewer) |

## Why self-host

Earlier these loaded from `esm.sh` and `cdn.jsdelivr.net` at runtime. On
flaky cellular networks (and inside the iPad PWA service worker) the 20
parallel cross-origin module imports for CodeMirror would intermittently
fail, surfacing as `TypeError: Importing a module script failed.` Vendoring
turns that into a single same-origin request that's cached by the browser
and the SW.

## Integrity

`purify.min.js` is the XSS sanitizer gate — its integrity matters most. Pinned
SHA-256 (verified by `tests/test_no_unsafe_sinks.py`):

```
dbabb5b205a333ec49c8c09e7fca30ef66df0523bb8bc0fa9ea843841f111dbd  purify.min.js
```

Regenerate after a DOMPurify bump: `sha256sum purify.min.js` and update this
line + the test.

## Rebuilding

```bash
cd tools && npm install
```

The `postinstall` hook in `tools/package.json` runs `npm run build`
automatically, so the vendor files are always in sync with whatever
`@codemirror/*` and `xterm*` versions `package.json` declares.

To rebuild without re-running `npm install` (e.g. after editing
`codemirror-entry.js`): `npm run build`. Per-target: `npm run
build:codemirror`, `npm run build:xterm`, `npm run build:marked`,
`npm run build:dompurify`, `npm run build:highlight`, or `npm run
build:github-markdown`.

Bump versions in `tools/package.json`, run `npm install`, and commit
the regenerated vendor files together with the lockfile change. The
CodeMirror entry list lives in `tools/codemirror-entry.js` — add new
symbols there if `editor-view.js` starts using them.
